premise: Nico's sand castle keeps crumbling, until a little wave shows him the trick: wet sand sticks together, and his castle stands at last.
inspiration: The three-tries folk pattern (the third son succeeds) with the answer found, not given: the sea itself shows him how.
lesson: Keep trying, and look around for the answer.
learning: Wet sand sticks together; dry sand crumbles.

en-US.title: The Castle That Stood
en-US.text: {surfer:enter} {surfer:go to sand} Nico wanted to build something amazing. {surfer:face happy} He filled {bucket:enter} his bucket {bucket:live} with soft, dry sand and patted it down. Then he tipped it over… {sfx:crumble} whoosh. It crumbled into a heap. {surfer:face sad} {surfer:says} [sad] "Oh no." He tried again. Crumble. {surfer:shake} And again. Crumble! [short pause] {surfer:go to shore} Nico went down to the water to think. A little wave washed over his toes, {surfer:face surprised} and where it had been, the ground was dark and firm. {surfer:says} [excited] "Wet sand sticks together! That's it!" He carried wet sand {surfer:go to sand} back up the beach. {bucket:pulse} Pat, pat, pat. He tipped it over. [in awe] It STAYED. One tower. Two towers. Three! {castle:enter} And there stood his sand castle, {castle:sparkle} with a little red flag on top. {castle:live} The flag fluttered in the breeze. {surfer:face happy} {surfer:hop x2} {surfer:says} [proudly] "The best sand castle ever."

es-ES.title: El castillo que aguantó
es-ES.text: {surfer:enter} {surfer:go to sand} Nico quería construir algo increíble. {surfer:face happy} Llenó {bucket:enter} su cubo {bucket:live} de arena suave y seca, y la aplastó bien. Luego le dio la vuelta… {sfx:crumble} fsss. Se deshizo en un montón. {surfer:face sad} {surfer:says} [sad] «Oh, no.» Lo intentó otra vez. Se deshizo. {surfer:shake} Y otra. ¡Se deshizo! [short pause] {surfer:go to shore} Nico bajó hasta el agua para pensar. Una ola pequeñita le mojó los pies, {surfer:face surprised} y donde había pasado, el suelo estaba oscuro y firme. {surfer:says} [excited] «¡La arena mojada se pega! ¡Eso es!» Subió arena mojada {surfer:go to sand} playa arriba. {bucket:pulse} Plas, plas, plas. Le dio la vuelta. [in awe] Y AGUANTÓ. Una torre. Dos torres. ¡Tres! {castle:enter} Y allí estaba su castillo de arena, {castle:sparkle} con una banderita roja arriba. {castle:live} La bandera ondeaba con la brisa. {surfer:face happy} {surfer:hop x2} {surfer:says} [proudly] «El mejor castillo del mundo.»
